Class CommandParser

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.client.ui.tui.utility.CommandParser
public class CommandParser extends Object
Utility class that parses raw TUI input strings into Command instances. Each recognized keyword maps to the corresponding command class; unrecognized keywords or malformed arguments return null and print an error message.

  • Method Details

    • parse

      public static Command parse(String input, Client client) throws InvalidLobbySizeException, InvalidTimingException
      Parses the given input string and returns the corresponding Command, or null if the input is unrecognized or malformed.

      Recognized commands:

      • move <n> — moves the player's pawn to tile n
      • create <n> — creates a new game with n players (2–5)
      • join — requests the list of available lobbies
      • choose <id> — joins the lobby with the given ID (only after join)
      • draw <id> — draws the card with the given ID
      • skip — skips the optional draw action
      • status — displays the status of all players
      • quit — exits the current match
      • exit — disconnects and terminates the application
      • help — displays the help screen
      • info <id> — displays the details of the card with the given ID
      • ranking — displays the global leaderboard
      • pgup — scrolls the players panel up by one player block
      • pgdn — scrolls the players panel down by one player block
      Parameters:
      input - the raw input string typed by the player
      client - the client instance, used to validate context-dependent commands such as choose
      Returns:
      the parsed Command, or null if the input is unrecognized, malformed, or cannot be executed in the current context
      Throws:
      InvalidLobbySizeException - if create is called with a player count outside the valid range (2–5)
      InvalidTimingException - if a command is issued at an invalid phase (propagated from the client)
